title: Senior Professional Services Consultant
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services team. This is a Hybrid, Mohali role , reporting to the Manager, Professional Services. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical authority for our enterprise customers - architecting, deploying, and optimizing solutions across the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform. As organizations navigate AI-accelerated threats, cloud-first transformation, and increasingly complex hybrid environments, you will be the expert who turns that complexity into clarity. You bring deep technical depth, a strategic consulting mindset, and the ability to engage equally well with hands-on engineering teams and senior business stakeholders - delivering outcomes that are secure, scalable, and built to last.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)  

• Own the full technical engagement lifecycle for enterprise customers - from discovery and solution design through deployment, adoption, and continuous optimization

• Architect and integrate ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, and the broader Zero Trust Exchange across complex, multi-cloud and hybrid enterprise environments including AI-driven workload scenarios

• Lead Zero Trust maturity assessments, technical discovery workshops, and migration planning sessions with customer and partner stakeholders at all levels

• Guide customers on securing modern identity frameworks, SaaS ecosystems, and AI-powered workflows - translating evolving threat landscapes into actionable, platform-led security outcomes

• Partner with sales, channel partners, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact consultancy and deployment services that accelerate customer time-to-value

Who You Are (Success Profile) 

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it

title: Compliance Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our company, Wolt License Services (WLS), is a dynamic organization specializing in payment and financial services for our parent company Wolt, a prominent platform marketplace, and Wolt’s customers. WLS currently manages all merchant payment flows across over 23 markets, ensuring strict adherence to regulatory requirements, including AML, safeguarding customer funds, and maintaining robust internal controls. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to operational teams. • Maintain accurate records of quality reviews, findings, root causes, corrective actions and quality metrics.

• Prepare regular quality assurance reporting, highlighting operational trends, recurring deficiencies, risk areas and improvement opportunities.

• Support root cause analysis of operational quality issues and collaborate with Product, Operations and Risk & Compliance teams to improve onboarding procedures and controls.

• Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures, quality checklists and onboarding guidance documentation.

• Promote a strong quality culture by encouraging operational excellence, continuous improvement and consistent application of operational standards across all markets.

Our humble expectations

• 2-4 years of experience in quality assurance, customer due diligence, merchant onboarding, financial crim

• Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor complex findings for frontline teams, technical partners, clients, and executives.

• Independent judgment and ownership, including the ability to move forward with limited structure once an objective is established.

• Ability to influence without relying on formal authority and to coordinate work across departments.

• Strong project execution skills and the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.

• Comfort challenging assumptions when the available evidence points in a different direction.

• Experience with payer reimbursement, claims adjudication, workflow design, or automation.

• Experience partnering with technical, product, or development teams.

title: Langfuse - Senior Cloud Infra Engineer
description:
WHY CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE AT LANGFUSE

Your work will keep Langfuse running - everywhere.

Langfuse processes over a billion trace events per month. When a Fortune 50 company relies on Langfuse in production, they're relying on the infrastructure you operate. You'll own uptime, performance, and cost efficiency across our entire cloud footprint - and you'll make sure every self-hosted deployment runs just as smoothly.

You'll operate Langfuse Cloud on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud, with Datadog as the observability backbone. You'll also own our public self-hosted infrastructure - including our Helm chart, Docker Compose setup, and everything in between - so that teams from startups to enterprises can run Langfuse on their own terms.

This isn't a "maintain what exists" role. We're scaling fast, and you'll be the person who makes sure the infrastructure grows ahead of demand - not behind it.

Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the team behind the database at the core of our stack is one channel away. Few infrastructure roles give you that kind of direct access to the people who build your most critical dependency.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

Own Langfuse Cloud operations: You'll run our production environments on AWS ECS Fargate and ClickHouse Cloud. You'll manage deployments, autoscaling, capacity planning, and cost optimization - making sure we stay fast and affordable as traffic scales.

Build world-class observability: You'll own our Datadog setup end to end - dashboards, alerts, and SLOs. When something degrades, you'll ensure we know before our customers do. You'll build the monitoring culture that lets the whole team ship with confidence.

Make self-hosting effortless: Thousands of teams run Langfuse on their own infrastructure. You'll own and evolve our Helm chart, Docker Compose configuration, and deployment documentation. You'll turn "works on my machine" into "works on every machine" - from a single-node setup to a multi-region enterprise deployment.

Automate everything: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, automated scaling, zero-downtime deployments. You'll replace manual processes with automation that makes the team faster and the platform more reliable.

Scale for what's next: We're growing fast and new product directions - like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation - push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale and building the foundation before we get there. 10x is always just one quarter away here at Langfuse.

Harden security and compliance: As more enterprises adopt Langfuse, you'll help ensure our cloud and self-hosted deployments meet the security and compliance bar that large organizations require.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong infrastructure or SRE engineer who gets excited about running systems at scale and making them better every day

- Experience operating production workloads on AWS (ECS/Fargate, networking, IAM, S3, etc.) or on comparable hyperscale vendors.

- Comfortable with container orchestration - Kubernetes and/or ECS, Helm charts, Docker

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar)

- Strong monitoring and observability instincts - you've built dashboards and alerts that actually caught problems (Datadog experience is a plus)

- You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about reliability, automation, and how to ship infrastructure changes safely

- Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment helping users debug their self-hosted deployments

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

Bonus points:

- Experience with ClickHouse Cloud or other managed analytical databases

- Background in operating high-throughput event processing or observability infrastructure

- Contributions to open source infrastructure tooling (Helm charts, Terraform module

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and strategic transactional attorney to join the IP team within our growing legal department. In this role, you will be responsible for the IP side of Anthropic's transactions, partnering with the M&A and commercial counsel who lead each deal. You will conduct IP diligence and negotiate IP terms for our acquisitions and investments, help advise on IP terms in our most complex commercial and research agreements, and drive the playbooks and processes that make our processes scalable. You will partner closely with the Head of IP (direct manager), our M&A and Commercial Legal teams, and Corporate Development on questions and issues that are very often new.

•
Lead the IP workstream on acquisitions and strategic investments, from diligence through letters of intent, definitive agreements, closing, and integration, alongside our M&A counsel and outside counsel

Partner with commercial counsel on the IP aspects of complex enterprise, partnership, research collaboration, and vendor agreements, advising on and negotiating IP terms

•
Serve as the primary point of contact on IP terms for commercial legal and other colleagues, and help train them so they can resolve more IP questions on their own

•
Drive the playbooks, templates, and processes that let a lean team handle IP terms across a high volume of deals

•
Contribute to broader IP strategy, particularly where transactions intersect with open source, trade secrets, patents, or new business models

Minimum qualifications

•
Hold a JD and are an active member of at least one U.S. state bar

•
Have substantial experience leading IP due diligence and negotiating IP terms in technology M&A

•
Have first-chair experience negotiating IP provisions in complex commercial technology agreements, such as licenses, joint development agreements, and services agreements

•
Have the ability to communicate IP risks and tradeoffs clearly to business leaders and non-specialist lawyers, and to exercise sound judgment about when to hold a position

•
Have strong working knowledge of open source licensing, employee and contractor IP assignment obligations, and trade secret protection

Preferred qualifications

•
10+ years of transactional IP experience at a nationally recognized law firm, a technology company, or both

•
Experience building negotiation playbooks, templates, or diligence processes that other lawyers relied on

•
Experience with AI, machine learning, data licensing, or other emerging technology

Curiosity about AI and a commitment to its responsible development

Aptive Resources is seeking an AI Subject Matter Expert with more than fifteen years of experience in the life sciences industry focused on creating and delivering data science and artificial intelligence solutions that accelerate healthcare innovation. In this role you will be Aptive ’s senior AI advisor supporting the Veterans Health Administration’s National Artificial Intelligence Institute by writing the playbooks and risk management guidance that VHA AI use case owners rely on, advising the governance bodies that decide which AI systems reach Veterans, and helping business units across the enterprise build AI strategies that hold up under federal scrutiny. • Develop training materials and deliver training webinars for AI use case owners and AI oversight personnel.

• Provide expert content and programming for the VHA AI Assessment Subcommittee, field AI committees, and other centralized governance entities, including trainings and summits.

• Research emerging AI risk management approaches and tools from published and publicly available literature, webinars, and vendor developments for briefings to Institute leadership and government stakeholders.

• Develop AI entrepreneur and adopter playbooks covering both internal development and vendor evaluation pathways.

Minimum Qualifications

•
Years of experience: More than 15 years of experience in the life sciences industry with a focus on creating and delivering data science and artificial intelligence solutions to accelerate healthcare innovation. Preferred: eight or more of those years developing or applying AI tools inside a healthcare enterprise at scale.

•
Required experience: Previous experience leading efforts to aggregate, analyze, and interpret health information. Previous experience using data platforms to scale machine learning algorithms through a ModelOps AI platform.

•
Degree: Doctorate degree in a computational, data science, health informatics, clinical, or life sciences discipline. Any doctorate is eligible, including a DrPH, MD, PhD, or ScD.

Licensure/certifications: None required. NIST AI Risk Management Framework training or an equivalent AI governance credential preferred.

Clearance: None required. Must be able to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated Tier 1 / National Agency Check with Written Inquiries (NACI) background inve

title: Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) - Springfield, MA
description:
Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

Job Description:
Blue Water Thinking is seeking an experienced and dedicated Senior Data Analyst to join our team, supporting the Integrated Healthcare Transformation (IHT) initiative at the Department of Veterans Affairs. • Apply in-depth knowledge of VHA systems and files, including CDW, VistA, VSSC, RAMP, PTF (MedSAS), MCA, PCMM, NPCD, and VETSNET.

• Strong experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlik.

• Demonstrated ability to interpret complex datasets and communicate findings to non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with VHA systems and data repositories, including CDW and VistA.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Public Health, or related discipline.

• Experience supporting federal healthcare programs, especially within the Department of Veterans Affairs.

Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

 

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Systems Safety Engineer to support Focused Energy's Austin facility as we advance the TTE project, laser project, and the transition toward operational readiness. This role is designed as an embedded engineering safety position rather than a standalone site-wide H&S management role. The Senior Systems Safety Engineer will work directly with engineering and operations teams to identify hazards, evaluate system risks, and develop practical mitigation strategies during system design, installation, validation, commissioning, and operation.

This role will partner closely with the central safety function, including safety system leadership defined in Germany, while providing strong local technical ownership for engineering safety execution in Austin. About Odyssey:

K-12 education is one of the most consequential determinants of a child’s future - and many families have had limited ability to shape how and where their child learns. Education Savings Account (ESA) programs are changing that. One of the fastest-growing public education initiatives in the U.S., they give states the ability to put education funding directly in the hands of families, who can then choose the learning experiences that best fit their child - from schools and tutors to therapy, curriculum, and technology.

But once these policies are signed into law, states face an enormous operational challenge. They must stand up entirely new programs, manage the secure and compliant flow of public funds, approve and monitor thousands of vendors, support families at scale, and prevent fraud - all while delivering a high-quality user experience.

That’s where Odyssey comes in.

We partner with state agencies to design, launch, and operate ESA and school chocie programs on their behalf. We provide the technology, program operations, vendor ecosystem, and family experience that make these programs actually work in the real world. Today, we operate across 10 states, and our platform powers programs serving 250,000+ students and over $2B in annual education funding - and we’re just getting started.

Most recently, we launched the Texas Education Savings Account (EFA) program - the biggest day-one ESA launch in the country - which has already received nearly 200,000 applications. It’s the kind of moment that captures exactly what we’re building toward: programs that work at scale, from day one, when it matters most.

We’re backed by respected investors, including a16z and Tusk Venture Partners, and we’re building the team that will take us to the next stage.

title: AI GTM Specialist
description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

Benchling is launching a new AI offering called “Decision Support”. You'll be the first hire dedicated to bringing it to market. You’ll have direct ownership of outbound sales pitch and demo,and will influence the GTM motion end to end. You’ll focus on decision support initially, and the role may expand into other AI GTM areas.

- Running outbound and demos independently.

- Run outbound to customer directors and VPs for new AI offerings.

- Deliver initial product demos to prospects and lead workshops.

- Act as the internal early adopter for new AI GTM motions, testing, refining, and rolling them out to the broader field team.

QUALIFICATIONS

-  2+ years in a customer-facing role: sales, solutions consulting, or similar.

- Comfort presenting to executives and running a room.

- Bias toward action in ambiguity; this SKU and this role are both being built in real time.

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

title: Field Enablement Manager - Sales

title: Manažer/ka úseku skladu | Area Manager
description:
Rohlik otevírá nové distribuční centrum v Opatovicích nad Labem. To vytváří jedinečnou příležitost být u všeho hned od začátku, vdechnout novému skladu život a postavit fungující tým na směně.

Nehledáme člověka do kanceláře, ale lídra přímo do provozu. V téhle roli budeš mít přímý vliv na to, jak se nový sklad rozjede, jaká v něm bude kultura a jak hladce bude každý den fungovat logistika pro tisíce zákazníků.

 

PROČ JE TAHLE ROLE ZAJÍMAVÁ

- Od nuly: Dostaneš šanci rozjíždět nový projekt na zelené louce a zanechat na fungování nového distribučního centra svůj přímý otisk.

- Reálný dopad: Budeš mít přímý vliv na výkon směny, efektivitu provozu i spokojenost svého týmu.

- Akční prostředí: Nečeká tě stereotypní kancelářská práce - budeš přímo v centru dění moderní e-commerce logistiky.

- Datově řízený provoz: Provoz řídíme na základě dat v reálném čase, takže budeš pracovat s moderními systémy a chytrými nástroji.

- Prostor věci měnit: Dostaneš samostatnost aktivně upravovat a zefektivňovat procesy tam, kde uvidíš příležitost ke zlepšení.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Vedení týmu: Budeš vést, motivovat a rozvíjet tým na směně, plánovat kapacity, rozdělovat práci a budovat týmovou spolupráci.

- Odpovědnost za výkon: Budeš řídit směnu podle klíčových ukazatelů (KPI) a zodpovídat za plnění plánovaných cílů.

- Práce s daty: Budeš sledovat provozní čísla v reálném čase, vyhodnocovat výkon a včas reagovat na odchylky.

- Optimalizace procesů: Budeš hledat úzká místa v provozu a aktivně navrhovat i zavádět zlepšení.

- Spolupráce napříč skladem: Budeš úzce spolupracovat s ostatními vedoucími, aby celý tok zboží fungoval plynule.

- Směnný provoz: Pracovat budeš v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden na 12hodinových denních a nočních směnách.

CO OD TEBE OČEKÁVÁME

- Zkušenost s vedením lidí: Máš prokazatelnou praxi s vedením, řízením a motivací týmu v dynamickém prostředí.

- Angličtinu pro běžnou pracovní komunikaci a řešení každodenních operativních situací.

- Analytické a IT základy: Umíš pracovat s daty, běžně používáš PC a rychle se zorientuješ v interních logistických systémech.

- Samostatnost a odpovědnost: Umíš se rozhodnout, převzít odpovědnost a dotahovat věci do konce.

- Chuť rozvíjet sebe i svůj tým a fungovat v prostředí, kde se věci rychle mění.

- Zkušenost ze skladu, logistiky nebo výroby je výhodou, ne však absolutní podmínkou - klíčový je pro nás tvůj lídrovský přístup.

CO TI ZA TVOU SKVĚLOU PRÁCI NABÍDNEME?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost extra placeného volna - když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočnout.

- Obědy & občerstvení zdarma - přímo na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce/zelenina každý den.

- Sbírej hvězdičky a ulov si odměnu - máme super systém vnitrofiremních pochval. S kolegy si navzájem posíláte hvězdičky, které pak snadno proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - ke každé směně ti přihodíme 86 Kč navíc na oblečení.

- Multisport karta - pro tvůj sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - umíme vzít za práci, ale i společně oslavit úspěchy na skvělých večírcích.

title: Program Manager - Finance
description:
About CWS
Imagine waking up every morning with the chance to change someone's life. Imagine knowing your efforts will benefit both your career and our neighbors around the world. At CWS, our team knows they are making a difference every day. Whether you're in our U.S.-based offices supporting refugees, asylees or unaccompanied children ... implementing hygiene initiatives in Cambodia or rebuilding projects in Central America ... or even connecting remotely from your home on fundraising campaigns, grant reports, or critical communications - you have the opportunity to work towards a world where everyone has food, a voice and a safe place to call home.
Overview
Church World Service (CWS) is a not-for-profit, faith-based organization transforming communities around the globe through just and sustainable solutions to hunger, poverty, displacement and disaster. CWS does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, or veteran status in employment or in the provision of services.
Purpose
The Program Manager - Finance is responsible for oversight of the financial operations of the Matching Grant (MG), Preferred Communities (PC) and Program for Initial Resettlement programs. In close collaboration with the CWS Corporate Finance Office, this position is responsible for developing, managing, and maintaining accounting and finance principles, practices, and procedures to ensure accurate and timely financial information is captured. This position will provide regular analysis of program budgets to the Resettlement and Integration Department Directors.
This position is funded by a grant with a program period ending September 2027.
Responsibilities
Essential Duties :

• Support the Directors in developing and monitoring budgets for the programs.

• Collaborate with the CWS Finance Office on all financial matters affecting the operations of programs.

• Ensures CWS financial policies, protocols and standards are followed.

• Ensures compliance with uniform guidance.

• Coordinating closely with CWS Finance and Projections Departments, create and manage regular reports, forecasts, and financial planning, and make recommendations to the program directors on budget and spending.

• Maintain excellent financial records. Establish and maintain a system to track program revenue and expenses for CWS programs and for subgrantees.

• Liaise regularly (monthly and quarterly) with program implementing sites, CWS Program Finance and CWS Program HQ to ensure regular submission of required financial reporting, troubleshoot as needed with implementing sites as needed

• Monitor monthly national and program site expenses to ensure that CWS programs are operating within their set budgets.

• Advise Directors on funding available to determine staff allocations and ensure relevant program salary allocations are accurate in HQ Finance records.

• In coordination with CWS Finance and Compliance Departments, draft guidance and template(s) for match backup documentation and tracking and providing TA on use.

• Create monthly spending reports for delivery to network for review/TA in coordination with Program Finance

• Creates new budget and relevant financial templates as needed

• Provide training to CWS HQ staff on programs site budget review

• Reviews and analyzes the actual vs budget report on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis for all active projects.

• Prepare and conduct financial portion of site visits and monitoring and evaluation (M&E) of subgrantees.

• Assist in preparation for audits by federal funders.

• Develop and maintain sound accounting procedures and practices.

Qualifications
Education & Certifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance or equivalent experience in lieu of degree.
Experience:

• Minimum of 6 years of previous work experience in non-profit accounting/finance with a strong working knowledge of nonprofit accounting/finance.

• Familiarity with OMB

title: Senior Front End Engineer - Remote
description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Front-End Engineer with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience in modern web application development. The ideal candidate must have deep expertise in JavaScript, React, and modern front-end architectures, along with strong hands-on experience in Node.js and advanced Server-Side Rendering (SSR) implementations.

This role requires a strong architectural mindset and the ability to work with different template engines and rendering frameworks, as some clients require working on various server-side template engines such as Pug, EJS, Handlebars, and other rendering solutions. The candidate must be comfortable adapting to multiple frameworks and enterprise environments.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design and development of scalable, enterprise-grade web applications using JavaScript (ES6+) and React.

• Architect and implement advanced Server-Side Rendering (SSR) solutions using frameworks such as Next.js or custom Node.js rendering pipelines.

• Work with and adapt to various template engines (e.g., Pug, EJS, Handlebars, JSX-based rendering) depending on client requirements.

• Design reusable, maintainable, and high-performance UI component libraries.

• Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js when required.

• Optimize rendering performance across client-side and server-side environments.

• Ensure SEO optimization and performance best practices in SSR-based applications.

• Collaborate with architects, backend teams, UI/UX designers, and stakeholders to define technical solutions.

• Conduct code reviews, enforce coding standards, and mentor junior developers.

• Participate in architectural decisions and technical roadmap planning.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in front-end development.

• Expert-level proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+).

• Advanced experience with React.js and modern React ecosystem (Hooks, Context API, advanced state management).

• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js in full-stack or SSR environments.

• Deep understanding of Server-Side Rendering (SSR), hydration, caching strategies, and rendering lifecycle.

• Proven experience working with multiple template engines and server-side rendering frameworks.

• Strong understanding of REST APIs and integration with backend services.

• Experience in performance optimization for large-scale web applications.

Preferred Qualifications

• Extensive experience with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks.

• Experience with TypeScript in large-scale applications.

• Knowledge of modern build tools (Webpack, Vite, Babel) and performance tuning.

• Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps collaboration.

• Strong understanding of SEO strategies in SSR applications.

• Experience in enterprise or multi-client delivery environments.

• Experience mentoring teams and leading technical initiatives.

Key Skills

• Strong architectural and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work across different frameworks and template engines based on client needs.

• Clean, scalable, and maintainable coding practices.

• Strong communication and leadership skills.

• Ability to handle complex enterprise environments and deadlines.

Our hotline operates 24/7, offering confidential and compassionate assistance to callers seeking help, information, and referrals to local treatment and support services. SafeSpot aims to reduce overdose deaths and improve access to addiction treatment and support across the state of Massachusetts.

The Hotline Operator plays a critical role at SafeSpot as the frontline point of contact with our callers. They will be responsible for managing incoming calls and talking with callers using a harm reduction framework. Hotline calls are opportunities to engage people who use drugs in meaningful conversation and the ideal candidate would be comfortable talking to people who are actively using drugs and who come from diverse backgrounds and experiences. This role is “pay per call” and has monthly call requirements in order to stay active on the team.

Answer calls, collects data for the State on callers to assist in service needs, provide callers with names and numbers for treatment.
